messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert: elevated 5xx rate observed from hosted inference control-plane (us-west1) — started ~2m ago. Trigger: 5xx rate > 3% for 1min. Auto-assigning pager to oncall.
Sarah H: oncall here, joining bridge now. seeing the alert. any quick notes on what changed in the last 10m?
Tony M: I pushed a routing reconciliation last 8m ago to fix sticky KV routing. It was a staged change but looks like a subset of backends got the new route while others didn't.
Ken L: I can see routing-controller logs showing "NACK" on a few syncs. suspect mismatch in route table version 42 -> 43. rolling reconcile job is still running.
Sarah H: ok — start a rollback of the reconcile if possible. if not, put an emergency rule to route away from affected backends.
Ken L: running manual rollback now:
```
# rollback routing version
kubectl -n routing exec job/reconcile-rollback -- /bin/sh -c "apply route-table:v42"
```
Ken L: rollback command submitted, logs show applied to 3/4 clusters. still pending for usc-west1-b nodepool-3.
PagerDaemon: NOTE: bridge created -> https://meet.redwood/support-bridge/1766004321 (auto).
Maria R: starting draft for statuspage — keep it concise. propose short/long forms.
Maria R: SHORT: "We are investigating elevated errors for hosted inference in us-west1 during a scheduled ops change. Some requests may return 5xx. Engineers are actively mitigating. Status updates every 15 minutes."
Maria R: LONG: "At 15:12 UTC we observed a spike in 5xx responses affecting a subset of hosted inference customers in us-west1. The spike coincided with a routing reconciliation job. Engineers have initiated a rollback of the routing change and are routing traffic away from impacted backends. Customers may see intermittent failures; no data loss is expected. We will provide updates and an incident summary after resolution."
Sarah H: +1 on those drafts. add estimated ETA for next update: +15. Also include a note for impacted customers to reach support with examples.
Tony M: i'm tailing the logs now — error signature is "kv-cache-miss with invalid token" which would come from mismatched route version. once rollback finishes errors should drop.
Ken L: rollback completed on 3/4, still failing on usc-west1-b due to node affinity mismatch. escalating to infra to force drain/recreate on that pool.
Sarah H: can we put a temporary routing rule to bypass usc-west1-b?
Ken L: doing that:
```
# add emergency route to skip nodepool
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/route/emergency \ 
  -d '{"from":"global","to":"region-us-west1-a,b","rule":"skip:usc-west1-b"}' 
```
Ken L: rule applied. traffic should reflow in ~30s.
PagerDaemon: Reaction: :thumbsup: from 3 users.
Maria R: pushed statuspage draft to staging. Planned update text ready — waiting for Sarah to approve for publish.
Sarah H: approve, publish now.
Maria R: Published status page incident 1766004321: https://status.redwood/incident/1766004321 — short text shown.
Tony M: error rate dropping in metrics — 5xx at 0.8% now, pre-incident baseline ~0.2%. keep monitoring.
Sarah H: good. start customer notification for customers with >1% errors in last 15m. Maria can you coordinate support DM and email template?
Maria R: on it. drafting email subject and body:
```
Subject: Service disruption (us-west1) — brief impact
Body: Hi <Customer>,
We experienced elevated error rates for hosted inference in us-west1 between 15:12–15:35 UTC during scheduled routing work. Impact: intermittent 5xx responses for some requests. Mitigation: rollback and routing bypass applied; normal service restored for most customers. Engineers are validating; follow-up report will be sent when investigation completes. If you have logs or examples, please reply to this thread or open a support ticket.
Apologies for the disruption,
Redwood Inference Support
```
Ken L: one more note — we should include the maintenance window id in the comms (MW-2026-03-15-02) so customers can correlate.
Maria R: added MW id to email. sending to support queue now for targeted customers.
Sarah H: next steps: 1) keep metrics alarm on 2) continue monitoring for 30m 3) if reoccurs move to SEV2 escalation. preparing handoff to night oncall at 18:00 UTC.
Tony M: I will leave logs tailing and alerts pinned.
Sarah H: handing off summary for night oncall:
- incident: elevated 5xx during routing reconciliation, rollback & emergency bypass applied.
- statuspage: published (link above).
- customers notified: targeted email + support DM.
- action items: monitor for flareups; if >1% sustained -> escalate.
Sarah H: @Ken L please add a one-line postmortem note in the incident doc once infra recreates the failing nodepool.
Ken L: will do.
PagerDaemon: Bridge closed by Sarah H. Reaction: :wave: 
Maria R: Thanks team — I'll post the follow-up summary once infra confirms final state. :email:
